review.instruction: Confirm admission, account, seed, flow, lease, attested endpoint and served head are current and mutually bound before execution. Missing prerequisites route to their owner and are not created here.
Match each case to the frozen written walk and actual browser result. Reject invented steps, prior-run captures, hidden skips and cases whose expected assertion was never exercised.
Judge behavior, data and experience separately from their own evidence. A failed or unavailable lane stays visible and cannot borrow another lane's pass.
Inspect actual screenshots and capture records, confirm credential fields were masked before capture, and verify no credential value appears in persisted artifacts.
Verify all created data stayed inside the seed namespace, cleanup removed only that namespace, and each run was appended under a new immutable run identity.

failurePolicy: Turn failed checks into concrete case defects, repair or rerun only affected steps under a new append-only attempt, reassess all affected lanes, and return done only when every criterion passes.
